sql.select: SELECT started_utc_seconds, completes_utc_seconds, weapon_id, shield_id, accessory_id, location_id, photo_variant_id, reward_equipment_id FROM active_rumble WHERE singleton_id = 1;
sql.insert: INSERT INTO active_rumble ( singleton_id, started_utc_seconds, completes_utc_seconds, weapon_id, shield_id, accessory_id, location_id, photo_variant_id, reward_equipment_id ) VALUES ( 1, @started_utc_seconds, @completes_utc_seconds, @weapon_id, @shield_id, @accessory_id, @location_id, @photo_variant_id, @reward_equipment_id ) ON CONFLICT(singleton_id) DO UPDATE SET started_utc_seconds = excluded.started_utc_seconds, completes_utc_seconds = excluded.completes_utc_seconds, weapon_id = excluded.weapon_id, shield_id = excluded.shield_id, accessory_id = excluded.accessory_id, location_id = excluded.location_id, photo_variant_id = excluded.photo_variant_id, reward_equipment_id = excluded.reward_equipment_id;
